executiveSummary:
Period overview: Last 30 days produced 348 incidents (337 resolved, 11 open), 4,685 security events (4,337 SSE, 347 endpoint, 1 network), 745 active assets (618 Win11), 520 users (388 medium-risk, 4 high-risk), and average risk score 60 (max 1000). Endpoint auto-remediation blocked removable media; SSE blocked thousands of web requests (top apps: WhatsApp, ChatGPT).  
Top cross-domain risks: (1) account misuse — 4 high-risk users generating excessive requests; enforce MFA, user behavior analytics, and targeted review. (2) web/cloud data exposure — 4,337 SSE events and high app use; tighten CASB policies and DLP. (3) malware/data-loss via endpoints — multiple high/critical EDR detections; validate containment and escalate forensic review.

findings.title: Critical Unauthorized File Operations
findings.description: Two critical 'Unauthorized File Operation Attempt' incidents on assets FISI and VP6-NRB detected and resolved.

findings.title: EDR Process Termination Attempts
findings.description: Multiple 'Attempt To Terminate Cynet Process' events across PKFMSA-LAO, L5ZQ-NRB, F15X-NRB resolved by EDR.

findings.title: High SSE Block Volume and Top App Use
findings.description: 4,337 SSE events; 92 critical denials; top apps include WhatsApp (782) and ChatGPT (718).
findings.mitreTechnique: T1195 - Supply Chain Compromise (cloud app misuse)

findings.title: High-risk User Activity Concentration
findings.description: Four high-risk users (iraintern 631 requests) generating disproportionate requests; denied counts low.
findings.affectedSystems: User accounts: iraintern, mmuthoni, vkibe, ynanzingwa

findings.title: Network Port Scanning Event
findings.description: Port scanning (TCP) observed targeting adikinim-KLA; no auto-remediation applied.

recommendations.title: Contain and Review Critical Endpoint Events
recommendations.description: Perform forensic review of the two critical Unauthorized File Operation incidents and revoke affected credentials.

recommendations.title: Harden EDR and Block Process Termination
recommendations.description: Enforce protection policies to prevent termination of defender processes and escalate persistent attempts.

recommendations.title: Strengthen CASB/DLP Policies
recommendations.description: Restrict risky apps, apply DLP on Google Drive/Gmail, and reduce unnecessary ChatGPT/WhatsApp access.

recommendations.title: Targeted User Risk Mitigation
recommendations.description: Apply MFA, session limits, and activity review for the four high-risk users; suspend if anomalous persists.

recommendations.title: Network Detection and Response Tuning
recommendations.description: Enable auto-remediation for port-scan signatures and correlate with endpoint telemetry for adikinim-KLA.

riskMatrix.treatmentPlan: Contain infected hosts, validate EDR remediation, escalate forensic analysis.
Tighten CASB/DLP, restrict high-risk apps, monitor uploads.
Enforce MFA, limit access, conduct targeted investigations.
Enable auto-blocking, inspect source and lateral movement.

sections.title: SSE / Web & CASB Events
sections.content: 4,337 SSE events in period; 92 critical denials. Top apps: WhatsApp (782), ChatGPT (718). High cloud/web usage increases data exposure risk.
sections.keyInsight: High web app usage drives most SSE blocks; tighten CASB and DLP.

sections.title: Endpoint Security
sections.content: 347 endpoint events: 28 high, 2 critical. EDR auto-remediation blocked removable media and prevented process termination attempts.
sections.keyInsight: EDR effective; critical file operations require forensic validation.

sections.title: Incident Management
sections.content: 348 incidents recorded; 337 resolved (96.6%), 11 open. Recent high/critical incidents were addressed via EDR and containment.
sections.keyInsight: High resolution rate; remaining open incidents need prioritized closure.

sections.title: Asset Inventory
sections.content: 745 active devices: 695 workstations, 50 servers. OS mix dominated by Windows 11 (618) and Windows 10 (84).
sections.keyInsight: Good asset visibility; validate patching status on servers.

sections.title: User Activity & Risk
sections.content: 520 users generated 113,762 requests; user risk: 388 medium, 128 low, 4 high. High-risk users require immediate review.
sections.keyInsight: Concentrated risk in four users; enforce controls and review activity.

complianceMapping.gap: User access controls and continuous monitoring need strengthening.
Asset change management and cloud controls require policy updates.
Access management and incident closure consistency needs evidence.
Environment segmentation and malware controls review required if card data present.

conclusion: Posture is developing: incident response and asset visibility are strengths; web/CASB and user risk require prioritised controls. Top priorities next period: (1) contain critical endpoint events and forensic review, (2) enforce CASB/DLP and app restrictions, (3) mitigate high-risk users with MFA and targeted monitoring.
